name: scs-v2-sealed-confirmation-acquisition
title: SCS v2 sealed confirmation acquisition
description: Discover 3-5 previously unexposed official SCS cruises from metadata and deployment geometry only, then acquire their raw archives as opaque sealed bytes with reproducible provenance and independent verification.
creator: Ruichen Zhou
notes: Stage A commit 948519b and Stage A.1 commit b6de3a6 are retained. Offline Stage A.2 completed in authoritative run 20260805T221441Z with verification=pass and downloader dry_run_pass. The immutable primary set is EQT20210702, EQT190012, EQT180002, TN352: 768 objects, 9,626,893,507 exact bytes, 5,606.374147 km official SCS track, below the 12 GiB cap. Two TN352 zero-byte .fnv sizes were recovered from frozen official directory HTML. SR1912/TN359 are excluded; TN358/TN354 are deferred with no replacement. v2-H remains pending_seal_and_processing, v2-W blocked_source_independence_unknown, confirmation_role_eligible=false, maximum post-download role sealed_unprocessed, and Stage B is not authorized.
